adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts` `createEvent` now selects the target `calendarId` based on the passed `credentialId` (`calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId`), but it sets the organizer attendee email from only the first destination calendar: `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = ...; email: mainHostDestinationCalendar?.externalId ? ... : calEventRaw.organizer.email`. When `destinationCalendar` contains multiple entries (as introduced in this diff), events created for non-first credentials will still use destinationCalendar[0].externalId as the organizer email, which is inconsistent with the selected calendar/credential and can lead to incorrect organizer/attendee state.
